What the studio does

Cuts

Layers, curtain bangs and new looks. Reviews describe small changes that transformed a whole look.

Colour

Hair colour appears five times among the review keywords. Customers write that the studio listened to the colour they wanted.

Treatments

Care treatments for the hair, such as the caviar treatment one review mentions next to a new cut.

Advice first

Before the scissors come out, you talk about what suits you best. Two reviews describe this conversation.

What customers notice

From the Google reviews.

The space

Atmosphere is by far the most frequent review keyword, 29 times. Reviews call the place peaceful and unique.

They listen

Customers write that their wishes were listened to carefully and the result was exactly the style they were looking for.

Room on short notice

One review tells of an appointment cancelled elsewhere three hours before, and this studio could still take the booking.

A studio on Yalta street

Groove’s Hair Studio is on Yalta street in Limassol, open five days a week. The studio’s own photos show a brick wall with wooden mirrors, brown leather chairs, a staircase behind an iron gate, a chandelier and plants everywhere. There is no website of its own: the Google listing has no website entry.
